parameters.query:
SELECT t.task_id, t.title, t.status, t.due_at, t.body
FROM jarvis_privat.task t
WHERE t.body->>'document_id' = $1 AND t.body->>'quelle' = 'auftrag_rolf'
ORDER BY t.created_at

SELECT d.document_id, d.status, d.original_filename, d.mime_type, d.source_external_id, d.received_at, d.size_bytes,
  d.body->'filing'->>'file_name' AS ablage_name,
  (SELECT to_jsonb(bp) FROM jarvis_privat.betreute_person bp
   WHERE bp.aktiv AND bp.person_key = COALESCE(CASE WHEN d.status <> 'filed' THEN a.body->'vorschlag'->>'person_key' END, d.person_key)) AS person,
  a.body AS analyse,
  (SELECT to_jsonb(f) FROM jarvis_privat.document_fall f WHERE f.fall_key = $3 AND f.active AND f.gruppe IN ('entwurf', 'aufgabe')) AS fall,
  (SELECT to_jsonb(t) FROM jarvis_privat.task t WHERE t.idempotency_key = $2) AS task,
  (SELECT s.todo_list_name FROM jarvis_ops.context_document_settings s WHERE s.context_id = 'privat') AS todo_liste,
  (SELECT m.body FROM jarvis_privat.memory_entry m
   WHERE m.memory_store = 'profile' AND m.entry_type = 'private_address' AND m.status = 'active' AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to > now())
   ORDER BY m.valid_from DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS privatadresse
FROM jarvis_privat.document d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT x.body FROM jarvis_privat.document_analysis x
  WHERE x.document_id = d.document_id
  ORDER BY x.analyzed_at DESC, x.analysis_id DESC LIMIT 1
) a ON true
WHERE d.document_id = $1 AND d.intake_adapter_id = 'web_desk_s1'

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.task (task_id, person_key, schema_version, context_id, title, success_criterion, actor, status, priority, due_at, idempotency_key, body, created_at, updated_at)
  SELECT p.j->>'task_id', p.j->>'person_key', '1.0.0', 'privat', p.j->>'titel', p.j->>'erfolg', 'rolf', 'open', 'high', NULL, p.j->>'idem',
    (p.j->'body') || jsonb_build_object('entwurf', jsonb_build_object('state', 'running', 'action_id', p.j->>'action_id', 'started_at', now())), now(), now()
  FROM p
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING task_id
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.task t
  SET body = t.body || jsonb_build_object('hinweis', p.j->'body'->'hinweis', 'versandform', p.j->'body'->'versandform', 'versandform_quelle', p.j->'body'->'versandform_quelle', 'entwurf', COALESCE(t.body->'entwurf', '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('state', 'running', 'action_id', p.j->>'action_id', 'started_at', now(), 'neu_fassen_offen', COALESCE((p.j->>'neu_fassen')::boolean, false))),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE t.idempotency_key = p.j->>'idem' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
    AND (COALESCE(t.body->'entwurf'->>'state', '') <> 'done' OR (COALESCE((p.j->>'neu_fassen')::boolean, false) AND t.status <> 'done'))
    AND NOT (t.body->'entwurf'->>'state' = 'running' AND (t.body->'entwurf'->>'started_at')::timestamptz > now() - interval '15 minutes')
  RETURNING t.task_id
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, task_id, action_id, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'task_created', 'rolf', ins.task_id, p.j->>'action_id', 'Auftrag erteilt: ' || (p.j->>'titel'),
    jsonb_build_object('document_id', p.j->'body'->>'document_id', 'art', p.j->'body'->>'art', 'quelle', 'auftrag_rolf')
  FROM ins, p
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT ((SELECT count(*) FROM ins) + (SELECT count(*) FROM upd))::int AS gesichert, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert

parameters.query:
SELECT t.task_id, t.title, t.status, t.due_at, t.body
FROM jarvis_privat.task t
WHERE t.task_id = $1 AND t.body->>'quelle' = 'auftrag_rolf'

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.task t
  SET status = 'done', body = t.body || jsonb_build_object('versand', (p.j->'versand') || jsonb_build_object('bestaetigt_at', now())), updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE t.task_id = p.j->>'task_id' AND t.status <> 'done' AND t.body->'entwurf'->>'action_id' = p.j->>'action_id'
  RETURNING t.task_id, t.title, t.status, t.due_at, t.body
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, task_id, action_id, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'task_completed', 'rolf', u.task_id, p.j->>'action_id', left(CASE WHEN u.body->>'art' = 'zahlen' THEN 'Zahlung als erledigt bestätigt: ' ELSE 'Auftrag als versendet bestätigt: ' END || u.title, 500), jsonb_build_object('nachweis', p.j->'versand'->>'methode')
  FROM u, p
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS bestaetigt,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_build_object('task_id', u.task_id, 'title', u.title, 'status', u.status, 'due_at', u.due_at, 'body', u.body) FROM u),
    -- CR-11 B6c: Zweite Bestätigung (Doppelklick, zweiter Tab) liefert den bereits erledigten Auftrag statt eines Fehlers.
    (SELECT jsonb_build_object('task_id', t.task_id, 'title', t.title, 'status', t.status, 'due_at', t.due_at, 'body', t.body) FROM jarvis_privat.task t, p WHERE t.task_id = p.j->>'task_id' AND t.status = 'done')) AS task,
  (SELECT j->>'task_id' FROM p) AS task_id

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.task t
  SET body = t.body || jsonb_build_object('entwurf', p.j->'entwurf')
             || CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.j->'todo') = 'object' THEN jsonb_build_object('todo', p.j->'todo') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
             || CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.j->'zahlung') = 'object' THEN jsonb_build_object('zahlung', p.j->'zahlung') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
             || CASE WHEN p.j->>'due' IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('frist', p.j->>'due', 'frist_quelle', 'ki') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END,
      due_at = CASE WHEN p.j->>'due' IS NOT NULL THEN ((p.j->>'due') || 'T12:00:00Z')::timestamptz ELSE t.due_at END,
      updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE t.task_id = p.j->>'task_id' AND t.body->'entwurf'->>'action_id' = p.j->>'action_id'
  RETURNING t.task_id, t.title, t.status, t.due_at, t.body
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, task_id, action_id, summary_de, body)
  SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.j->'zahlung') = 'object' THEN 'task_prepared' ELSE 'draft_created' END, 'jarvis', u.task_id, p.j->>'action_id', left(COALESCE(p.j->>'log_text', 'Entwurf angelegt'), 500),
    jsonb_build_object('nachweis', COALESCE(p.j->>'nachweis', 'readback_isDraft_action_id'), 'todo_state', p.j->'todo'->>'state', 'art', u.body->>'art')
  FROM u, p
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS aktualisiert, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert,
  (SELECT jsonb_build_object('task_id', u.task_id, 'title', u.title, 'status', u.status, 'due_at', u.due_at, 'body', u.body) FROM u) AS task

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
a AS (
  -- CR-11 E3: Scheitert «Neu fassen», bleibt der bisherige (fertige) Entwurf gültig.
  SELECT t.task_id,
    (COALESCE((t.body->'entwurf'->>'neu_fassen_offen')::boolean, false) AND COALESCE(t.body->'entwurf'->>'message_id', '') <> '') AS behalten,
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.body->'entwurf'->'hinweise') = 'array' THEN t.body->'entwurf'->'hinweise' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END AS hinweise
  FROM jarvis_privat.task t, p
  WHERE t.task_id = p.j->>'task_id'
),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.task t
  SET body = jsonb_set(t.body, '{entwurf}', CASE WHEN a.behalten THEN
        COALESCE(t.body->'entwurf', '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('state', 'done', 'neu_fassen_offen', false,
          'letzter_fehler', (p.j->'fehler') || jsonb_build_object('at', now()),
          'hinweise', jsonb_build_array('Neu fassen fehlgeschlagen: ' || COALESCE(p.j->'fehler'->>'text', 'unbekannter Fehler') || ' Der bisherige Entwurf gilt – massgebend ist der Text in Outlook.')
            || COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.hinweise) x WHERE (x #>> '{}') NOT LIKE 'Neu fassen fehlgeschlagen:%'), '[]'::jsonb))
      ELSE
        COALESCE(t.body->'entwurf', '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('state', 'failed', 'fehler', p.j->'fehler', 'failed_at', now())
      END),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM p, a
  WHERE t.task_id = a.task_id AND t.body->'entwurf'->>'action_id' = p.j->>'action_id' AND t.body->'entwurf'->>'state' = 'running'
  RETURNING t.task_id, a.behalten
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, task_id, action_id, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'draft_failed', 'jarvis', u.task_id, p.j->>'action_id',
    CASE WHEN u.behalten THEN 'Neu fassen fehlgeschlagen – bisheriger Entwurf bleibt gültig' ELSE 'Auftrag konnte nicht ausgeführt werden' END,
    jsonb_build_object('code', COALESCE(p.j->'fehler'->>'code', 'draft_failed'), 'bisheriger_entwurf_gilt', u.behalten)
  FROM u, p
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS zurueckgesetzt, COALESCE((SELECT u.behalten FROM u), false) AS behalten

SELECT t.task_id, t.status, t.body, a.body->'ki' AS ki,
  fc.adresse_zweck, COALESCE(fc.empfaenger_ist_absender, true) AS empfaenger_ist_absender,
  ft.target_id, ft.provider_label, ft.contact_email, ft.contact_email_source_url,
  (SELECT jsonb_build_object('email', o.body->'entwurf'->>'empfaenger_email', 'quelle_url', o.body->'entwurf'->>'empfaenger_quelle_url')
   FROM jarvis_privat.task o
   WHERE o.task_id <> t.task_id AND o.body->>'quelle' = 'auftrag_rolf'
     AND lower(o.body->'entwurf'->>'vertragspartner') = lower(t.body->'entwurf'->>'vertragspartner')
     AND o.body->'entwurf'->>'empfaenger_bestaetigt_at' IS NOT NULL
   ORDER BY o.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS frueher
FROM jarvis_privat.task t
LEFT JOIN jarvis_privat.document_fall fc ON fc.fall_key = COALESCE(t.body->>'art', 'kuendigen')
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT x.body FROM jarvis_privat.document_analysis x
  WHERE x.document_id = t.body->>'document_id'
  ORDER BY x.analyzed_at DESC, x.analysis_id DESC LIMIT 1
) a ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT f.target_id, f.provider_label, f.contact_email, f.contact_email_source_url
  FROM jarvis_privat.filing_target f
  WHERE f.active AND COALESCE(fc.empfaenger_ist_absender, true) AND f.category_key = a.body->'ki'->>'kategorie_key'
    AND f.sub_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (a.body->'ki'->>'sparte_key')
    AND (lower(a.body->'ki'->>'absender_kurz') = ANY (f.aliases) OR lower(a.body->'ki'->>'absender') = ANY (f.aliases) OR lower(t.body->'entwurf'->>'vertragspartner') = ANY (f.aliases))
  ORDER BY f.target_id LIMIT 1
) ft ON true
WHERE t.task_id = $1 AND t.body->>'quelle' = 'auftrag_rolf'

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.task t
  SET body = jsonb_set(t.body, '{entwurf}', (t.body->'entwurf') || jsonb_build_object('empfaenger_email', p.j->>'email', 'empfaenger_quelle', p.j->>'quelle', 'empfaenger_quelle_url', p.j->'quelle_url', 'empfaenger_bestaetigt_at', now(), 'fehlende_angaben', p.j->'fehlende')),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE t.task_id = p.j->>'task_id' AND t.status <> 'done' AND t.body->'entwurf'->>'action_id' = p.j->>'action_id'
  RETURNING t.task_id
),
f AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.filing_target ft
  SET contact_email = p.j->>'email', contact_email_source = p.j->>'quelle', contact_email_source_url = p.j->>'quelle_url', contact_email_confirmed_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  FROM p, u
  WHERE ft.target_id = p.j->>'target_id' AND p.j->>'quelle' IN ('rolf', 'web')
  RETURNING ft.target_id
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, task_id, action_id, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'draft_recipient_set', 'rolf', u.task_id, p.j->>'action_id', 'Empfängeradresse im Entwurf eingetragen und nachgelesen',
    jsonb_build_object('quelle', p.j->>'quelle', 'nachweis', 'readback_toRecipients', 'register_aktualisiert', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM f))
  FROM u, p
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS aktualisiert, (SELECT count(*) FROM f)::int AS register, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert

WITH u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.task t
  SET status = 'cancelled', body = t.body || jsonb_build_object('geschlossen', jsonb_build_object('at', now(), 'von', 'rolf', 'grund', t.body->'entwurf'->'fehler'->>'code')), updated_at = now()
  WHERE t.task_id = $1 AND t.body->>'quelle' = 'auftrag_rolf' AND t.status NOT IN ('done', 'cancelled')
    AND (t.body->'entwurf'->>'state' = 'failed'
         OR (t.body->'entwurf'->>'state' = 'running' AND (t.body->'entwurf'->>'started_at')::timestamptz < now() - interval '15 minutes'))
  RETURNING t.task_id, t.title, t.body
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, task_id, action_id, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'task_cancelled', 'rolf', u.task_id, u.body->'entwurf'->>'action_id', left('Auftrag geschlossen: ' || u.title, 500),
    jsonb_build_object('grund', u.body->'entwurf'->'fehler'->>'code', 'art', u.body->>'art')
  FROM u
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS geschlossen, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert,
  (SELECT u.body->'todo'->>'state' FROM u) AS todo_state
SELECT s.drafts_ref FROM jarvis_ops.context_document_settings s WHERE s.context_id = 'privat'

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.task t
  SET body = t.body || jsonb_build_object('brief', p.j->'brief'), updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE t.task_id = p.j->>'task_id'
  RETURNING t.task_id
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, task_id, action_id, summary_de, body)
  SELECT CASE WHEN p.j->'brief'->>'state' = 'done' THEN 'draft_created' ELSE 'error_recorded' END, 'jarvis', u.task_id, p.j->'brief'->>'action_id',
    CASE WHEN p.j->'brief'->>'state' = 'done' THEN left('Briefdokument angelegt: ' || COALESCE(p.j->'brief'->>'name', ''), 500) ELSE left(COALESCE(p.j->'brief'->>'fehler', 'Briefdokument fehlgeschlagen'), 500) END,
    jsonb_build_object('brief', p.j->'brief')
  FROM u, p
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS aktualisiert, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert
